next_gates.authorization-required: Obtain the applicable exact authorization before execution.
next_gates.certificate-gates: Complete the existing certificate and other readiness gates.
next_gates.cleanup-required: Complete the separately authorized evidence-preserving cleanup.
next_gates.evidence-admission: Complete separately governed evidence review and admission.
next_gates.next-authorized-shard: Proceed only under a separately valid shard authorization and its prerequisites.
next_gates.none: No next action is inferred from this record.
next_gates.review-failure: Review the retained failure before proposing any retry or correction.
next_gates.review-format-recovery: Review the pending metadata-only recovery, then use the existing exact validation and CI gates. No workload is authorized by this report.

reasons.authorization-expired: The recorded authorization window expired. This report does not renew it.
reasons.blocker-changed: The recorded blocker or next permitted action changed; no additional authority is granted.
reasons.ci-terminal: The governed CI job reached a terminal result. CI is not native qualification.
reasons.cleanup-verified: The registered cleanup record reports verification. This reporter did not inspect live resources.
reasons.correction-merged: A reviewed correction was merged. A merge is not evidence of a subsequent qualification pass.
reasons.evidence-admitted: Evidence was admitted through the canonical qualification process; the report only reflects its ledgers.
reasons.evidence-gap: A retained evidence gap was registered. Missing original content is not reconstructed.
reasons.preflight-refused: A prerequisite refused execution; this activity is not a workload result.
reasons.review-format-refusal: The Windows continuation stopped before tests because the review record used bare digest strings where the caller required a sha256: prefix. The digest values matched. This is a review-to-caller formatting failure, not a new Windows workload result.
reasons.run-completed: The registered run completed; credit changes only after canonical evidence admission.
reasons.run-failed: The registered run failed. Its original outcome is retained; the cause requires evidence-backed review.
reasons.run-interrupted: The registered run was interrupted; no successful completion is inferred.
